summary: Frontend-only test of the new WhatsApp-style Group info (WorkchatGroupInfo.jsx) for the worker and employer roles at 1920x1080 and 390x844, a check of the iteration_7 fixes, and a contrast and pink DOM scan of worker, employer, admin and landing pages. GROUP INFO WORKING: (1) The header title (aria-label 'Open group information') opens [data-testid=workchat-group-info]. On desktop it sits at x=248, width 1672, so it does not cover the side menu; on mobile it is 390x844 with no horizontal overflow. (2) It has a navy bar with a back button (group-info-back closes it), a 112px avatar, the name 'Riverside Fest Crew 🎪' and 'Group · 5 members'. (3) The about card reads 'Everyone in this group can send messages. Created by Sam Demo, 3 November 2026'. (4) The media strip shows a GIF thumbnail; clicking it opens group-info-lightbox and clicking the lightbox closes it. (5) The member list puts 'You' first with no stray '0' text. (6) Worker: Exit group is disabled; there are no Add, Lock, add-row, settings or delete controls. (7) Employer: Add, Lock chat and 'Add or manage members' (opens the Manage participants panel and closes the info) are present, as are Group settings and Delete group (the confirm was dismissed). (8) Lock chat, after accepting the confirm, flips the label to 'Unlock' and the about text to 'Only admins can send messages right now.'. Toggling back restores 'Lock chat'. (9) The three-dots menu item 'Group info' (workchat-menu-group-info) opens the info. (10) Opening another workchat closes the info; Friday Bar Team then shows 3 members and the 'No photos or GIFs shared yet' empty state. GROUP INFO ISSUES: (1) The Search action does nothing useful. It closes the info, but the message-search input is display:none (the .workchat-header-search label has no 'open' class), so focus stays on BODY. Seen on desktop and mobile. (2) The 5th member avatar is pink (#DB2777 in the TONES array). (3) The lightbox (position:fixed, z-index 200) does not dim the side menu. (4) The worker 'Exit group' row is permanently disabled, although the three-dots menu 'Exit group' (leaveWorkchat) works. (5) The group creator and employer, Sam Demo, has no 'Group admin' badge. ITERATION 7 FIXES VERIFIED: the group workchat no longer covers the side menu; admin Financial Reports values are navy; admin tabs are pills with no black strips; admin message cards are light blue and readable; the BLOCKED and PENDING count badges are sunshine with navy text; the employer favourites text is readable; the instant-pay 'unavailable' badge is grey (no pink); the own-bubble 'Replying to' text is #1D5EC2; the landing 'Find work on the go.' heading and footer headings are white; direct chat avatars are no longer crimson or plum. NOT FIXED: (1) The landing active about tab (.public-intro-tabs button.active), the carousel dot and the app-visual tabbar 'Home' are white on #EBF5FF (contrast 1.10). (2) On mobile Jobs, the today card has height 0 and the Clock in button is covered by the job tabs. (3) The 'Next 6 weeks' heading is navy on navy. (4) The timetable selected cell (Nov 28) is navy on navy, and the legend still says 'Orange dates'. (5) The Publish-a-shift callout is still peach with an orange border, and the action row is still unbalanced.

ui_bugs.issue: onSearch closes the info and focuses '.workchat-header-search input', but that label is display:none unless workchatMessageSearch is truthy (class 'open'). The input cannot take focus, so activeElement stays BODY. Fix: call setWorkchatMessageSearch(' ') before focusing, as the header search icon does, or reuse the header icon's onClick (App.jsx lines 701 and 797).

Not fixed from iteration 7: .worker-todays-shift-wrap is top 93, height 0, and the job tabs (top 117, height 104) are drawn over the Today's shift card. elementFromPoint on Clock in does not return the button, so Clock in cannot be used on mobile.

The Nov 28 selected cell is navy text on a navy background (contrast 1.0). The legend still says 'Orange dates have confirmed shifts'. '1 shift' is dark text on blue cells. The Mon/Tue/Wed column headers do not match the dates: Nov 5 2026 is a Thursday but sits in the Mon column, while the Jobs calendar correctly shows THU 5. This looks like a date-alignment bug.
Not fixed: the active 'About us' tab is white on #EBF5FF (contrast 1.10) and invisible. The same applies to .public-intro-dots button.active and .app-visual-tabbar span.active ('Home').

integration_issues.issue: In group info the 'Exit group (ask the employer)' button is always disabled, yet the three-dots menu 'Exit group' calls leaveWorkchat and works. The two disagree; wire the row to leaveWorkchat or remove the menu item.

issues: TONES in WorkchatGroupInfo.jsx includes #DB2777 (pink), used for the 5th member (Sam Demo for the worker, Priya Shah for the employer). Replace it with a palette colour.
The lightbox does not cover the side menu; only the content area is dimmed. It also shows the GIF at its natural 370px instead of scaling it up.
The creator and employer has no 'Group admin' badge (is_admin is not set for the employer), so the list has no admin marker.
The worker 'Exit group' row is shown in faded red (opacity .55); it looks broken rather than informative.

design_issues.screen: Manage participants panel (opened from group info)
issues: Unstyled: no padding (content is flush to the left edge at x=248), native grey 'Remove' buttons, and names run into emails ('Sam Demodemo.employer@...'). It looks out of place next to the polished group info.
The group avatar 'RF' is white on sunshine (contrast 1.54).
The reaction count '2' is #E5B22B on light blue (contrast 1.62).
The 'You' quote label in the direct chat is sunshine on light grey (low contrast).
The 'Next 6 weeks' strong is navy on navy (contrast 1.0); not fixed.
Not fixed: the .cluster-current-shift-heading background is rgb(255,248,242) (peach) with an rgb(233,90,19) orange left border, and 'in cluster' is orange-red.

The action row is still unbalanced: 'Save as template only' is 938px wide while 'Review & publish cluster' (178px) and 'Private offer' (120px) are squeezed to the right. The disabled publish button is a washed-out blue.
The New shifts cards (Create cluster / Create individual shifts) use a system/Arial font instead of DM Sans/Outfit.
The intro carousel section background is warm beige rgb(247,242,233), not off-white #F7F8FA.
The tab rows are duplicated: a pill row 'MESSAGES / + NEW MESSAGE / NOTIFICATIONS' is followed by a blue row 'MESSAGES / + NEW MESSAGE / SEND NOTIFICATION'.
There is still a white box behind the 'Dashboard' h1 on the off-white page.
The Users 'Create Taylor Worker test checkout' banner has a beige/peach dashed background.
The side menu uses text glyphs ('▦', '○') instead of lucide icons.
The Sam Demo avatar is olive green rgb(77,124,15) in the room header but blue in the inbox list. Not crimson any more, but still inconsistent.

action_items: Fix the group-info Search action: setWorkchatMessageSearch(' ') before focusing #worker-workchat-header-search / #employer-workchat-header-search
Remove the pink #DB2777 from TONES in WorkchatGroupInfo.jsx
Make the lightbox cover the whole viewport (portal to document.body or raise above the side menu)
Make the worker 'Exit group' row consistent with the menu (call leaveWorkchat) and show a 'Group admin' badge for the employer/creator
Style the Manage participants panel (padding, buttons, name/email separation)
Fix mobile Jobs today-card collapse / Clock in overlap (CRITICAL, from iteration 7)
Fix 'Next 6 weeks' contrast, the timetable selected cell, the 'Orange dates' legend and the timetable weekday alignment (Nov 5 2026 is a Thursday)
Fix landing .public-intro-tabs button.active, .public-intro-dots button.active and .app-visual-tabbar span.active contrast; carousel bg to #F7F8FA
Restyle the Publish-a-shift callout (remove peach/orange) and rebalance the action row
Raise contrast of the workchat header avatar (white on sunshine) and the sunshine reaction count
Remove the duplicated admin Messages tab row
critical_code_review_comments: WorkchatGroupInfo is rendered twice in App.jsx (lines 701 and 797) with the same long, duplicated props, and App.jsx is a very large single-line component. Extract a shared prop builder.
isOwner={user?.role==='employer'} shows Delete group to any employer participant, not just the group owner. Compare with info.created_by.
workchatItems.find(...) is called 4 or more times per render in the header and props. Memoise the current chat.
The links regex also matches GIF URLs that end with a query string; this is handled by the !u.match(MEDIA_RE) filter. OK.
updated_files: /app/tests/scan.js (new test helper only, no app code changed)

success_rate.frontend: Group info: 13/16 checks pass. Iteration 7 fixes: 10/15 verified fixed

seed_data_creation: None created. The employer toggled Lock chat on and then off on Riverside Fest Crew, leaving it in its original state. No messages were sent and the delete confirm was dismissed. Per the test-data rules, scripts/seed-demo-data.js was NOT run even though the request asked; the main agent can run it if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: POST /api/auth/login in the page, set localStorage 'hyrz_token', reload. Desktop nav: page.locator('button:visible').filter(has_text='Inbox'); then the 'Workchats' button, then '.workchat-wa-row' filtered by 'Riverside'. Open group info with get_by_label('Open group information'). Confirm dialogs (lock and delete) need an explicit accept or dismiss handler. The contrast and pink scanner is /app/tests/scan.js; use page.evaluate(open(path).read()).
